specs.title: TC-01 Calculating with valid input returns all three figures
TC-02 Calculating with an empty form reports required fields
TC-04 Property price of zero does not produce a result
TC-05 Negative amounts are rejected by the inputs
TC-06 Non-numeric input is not accepted
TC-07 Financing term of zero is rejected (no division by zero)
TC-08 Zero interest rate still calculates
TC-09 Down payment above 100% is rejected
TC-10 Monthly income below the allowed minimum is rejected
TC-11 Monthly income above the allowed maximum is rejected
TC-12 Monthly income exactly at the boundaries is accepted
TC-13 Two radio groups are mandatory
TC-14 Clear resets every field and radio groups
TC-15 Recalculating with a new price replaces the previous result
TC-16 Amount fields format with a currency prefix and separators
TC-17 Calculator is usable without logging in
TC-18 Beneficiary answer changes the calculation
